_help: First-time hints: Hints.once(id) shows one the first time its mechanic comes up (flag hint_<id>, saved with the game; never during a conversation or an open screen). Played by scripts/hints.gd. secs = how long it stays (default 5).

aim_fire.text: Right mouse: aim.  Left mouse: fire.

reload.text: {reload}: reload. Count your shots: a revolver holds six.

holster.text: {holster}: holster or draw your gun. People talk more easily to an unarmed man.

switch_guns.text: {weapon_1}, {weapon_2}, {weapon_3} or the mouse wheel: switch guns.

cover.text: {cover} beside a wall or crate: take cover. Aim (right mouse) to lean out and shoot.

vault.text: In cover behind something low: {move_forward} + {cover} vaults over it.

dodge.text: {dodge}: a dodge roll. For a moment nothing can touch you.

crouch.text: {crouch}: crouch. Harder to see, harder to hit.

journal.text: Written in your journal. {journal} opens it.

codex.text: {journal}, then Tab: the people you've met, and what you know of them.

orders.text: {party_order}: tell your companions to hold where they stand, or to follow you again.

help_up.text: A companion is down! Go to them and press {cover} to help them up.

gunner_seat.text: {swap_seat}: a companion takes the wheel and you take the gun.

driving.text: {move_forward} / {move_back}: faster and slower.  {move_left} / {move_right}: steer.  {cover}: get out.

riding.text: {move_forward} / {move_back}: faster and slower.  {move_left} / {move_right}: steer.  {cover}: get down.

action_menu.text: Each thing you do here costs time: three actions a day. Buying is free; talking takes an action.

days.text: Today's actions are spent. Sleep to begin the next day.

route_board.text: Pick a route: the card shows its days, risk and cost. Click it again (or Enter) to set off.

slabs.text: A slab is grinding down! Sprint ({sprint}) and get under it before it closes.

scarabs.text: Scarabs can't bear fire. Keep to the torchlight and keep moving.

guardian.text: The guardian can't be killed. Bullets only slow him. Run, or lead him away.

brawl.text: Fists: left mouse punches (again for a cross), right mouse blocks, {shove} shoves.
